title: Coefficient data for strict Kummer adjunct compatibility
statement: This node defines, rather than proves, the following compatibility proposition and its coefficient data. In the generic version, take abelian categories A and B with small Ext, derived categories of A and strict inverse B-systems, an adjunction L left adjoint to U, a simultaneous reduction D of L, exact coefficient restriction functors F_n:C_n→B and V_n:C_n→A from small-Ext abelian categories, objects M in A and P_n in C_n, a prescribed roots tower, classes κ_n in Ext¹(M,V_n P_n), and a roots-map normalization predicate. KummerTargetAdjunctCompatibility is the proposition that there exist H, roots, b and t_n with that normalization, and that every source counit a, source comparison s, quotient-unit map g, arrow f and supplied residue lift e as specified below satisfy the negative product formula. kummerComparedUnit is the positive units-comparison class followed by the positive pro-etale Kummer unit. kummerRootNormalization is equality of the underlying level map with the roots comparison followed by the canonical roots-to-line map. kummerStrictAdjunctCompatibilityStatement is precisely the following concrete proposition: Let $\ell$ be prime and invertible on an arbitrary scheme $W$, and let $D$ be a simultaneous derived reduction of scalar extension [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], using [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext]. Write $U$ for forgetting p-adic scalars, $F_n$ for restriction from $\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1}$ to $\mathbf Z_\ell$, and $G_m^{comp}$ for the comparison pullback of the etale units sheaf. There exist a strict constant-p-adic system $H$, an isomorphism $roots:H\circ U\simeq(\mu_{\ell^{n+1}})_n$ to the actual roots tower [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], an isomorphism $b:D.T(G_m^{comp}[1])\simeq H[2]$, and level isomorphisms $t_n:H_n\simeq F_n((\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})(1))$, with $U(t_n)=roots_n$ followed by the canonical roots-to-line map [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data]. For any level $n$, abelian source $S$, canonical invertible source counit $a$, residue sheaf $Q$, isomorphism $s:D.ordinary(S)_n\simeq F_nQ$ and map $g:S\to forget(Q)$ equal to the quotient-adjunction unit under $s$, take any $f\in Ext^1(S,G_m^{comp})$. If a residue class $e\in Ext^2(Q,(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})(1))$ has restriction equal to evaluation of $a^{-1}D.T(f)b$ under $s,t_n$, then its scalar adjunct is $-f\kappa_n$, where $\kappa_n$ is the positive Kummer class preceded by the units comparison. This is a conditional compatibility equation for any supplied residue lift; existence of such a lift is not a conclusion.

def KummerTargetAdjunctCompatibility
    (ℓ : ℕ) {A : Type*} [Category A] [abA : Abelian A] [hA : HasExt.{w} A]
    {B : Type*} [Category B] [abB : Abelian B] [hB : HasExt.{w} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    [HasExt.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B)]
    (L : A ⥤ B) (U : B ⥤ A) (ad : L ⊣ U) (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ L)
    (C : ℕ → Type*) [catC : ∀ n, Category (C n)] [abC : ∀ n, Abelian (C n)]
    [hC : ∀ n, HasExt.{w} (C n)]
    (F : ∀ n, C n ⥤ B) [Fadd : ∀ n, (F n).Additive]
    [Flim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteLimits (F n)]
    [Fcolim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteColimits (F n)]
    (V : ∀ n, C n ⥤ A) [Vadd : ∀ n, (V n).Additive]
    [Vlim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteLimits (V n)]
    [Vcolim : ∀ n, PreservesFiniteColimits (V n)]
    (M : A) (rootsTower : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (P : ∀ n, C n)
    (κ : ∀ n, Ext M ((V n).obj (P n)) 1)
    (rootNorm : ∀ H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B, (H ⋙ U ≅ rootsTower) →
      ∀ n, (H.obj (op n) ≅ (F n).obj (P n)) → Prop) : Prop
